about.title: Congolese expertise, built for industrial power
about.body: Founded in 2021 in Lubumbashi, ELMA SERVICES was born from a simple observation: major industrial and mining sites in the region need qualified local expertise in designing, building and maintaining electrical substations and lines, from low to extra-high voltage. Since then, our teams have worked on installations ranging from 24 V to 245 kV, with the same commitment to safety and technical rigor.

maintenance-preventive.title: Why preventive high voltage maintenance avoids costly outages
maintenance-preventive.excerpt: An undetected hot spot can take a line down for hours. Here's how regular thermographic inspection limits that risk.
maintenance-preventive.body:
On an industrial or mining site, an unplanned electrical outage rarely costs just the repair time: it also halts production upstream and downstream. Preventive high voltage maintenance exists precisely to reduce this risk, by identifying signs of failure before they become critical.

Thermographic inspection is one of the most effective tools for this: a thermal camera can spot a hot point on a connection, breaker or transformer that is often invisible to the naked eye but reveals a loose connection or wear. Combined with regular earthing network measurements and documented equipment tracking, it turns emergency repairs into planned interventions.

At ELMA SERVICES, this approach is part of our routine work on industrial and mining sites around Lubumbashi: regular diagnostics, detailed reports and concrete recommendations to prioritize maintenance work.

mise-a-la-terre.title: Earthing networks: a site's most underrated protection
mise-a-la-terre.excerpt: A poorly sized earthing network endangers equipment as much as people. A refresher on best practices.
mise-a-la-terre.body:
Earthing is often the least visible part of an electrical installation — and yet one of the most critical. A properly sized earthing network dissipates fault currents, protects sensitive equipment and limits risk to people on site.

In industrial and mining environments, several factors complicate this: soil composition, variable moisture, large metal structures, or a site that has grown through successive extensions. That's why an earthing network needs to be studied, measured and documented, then checked regularly — not just installed once and forgotten.

This is the first trade ELMA SERVICES was built on back in 2021, with dozens of earthing network diagnostics and improvements delivered for a local industrial client base.

devis-electrique.title: How to prepare a quote request for an industrial electrical project
devis-electrique.excerpt: The more precise a quote request, the faster and more reliable the technical response and pricing will be.
devis-electrique.body:
Whether it's building a line, inspecting a substation or a maintenance visit, the quality of a quote depends directly on the quality of the information shared upfront.

A few details save valuable time: the type of installation involved (voltage, age, location), the nature of the need (new construction, maintenance, inspection, study), the site context (access, safety constraints, possible intervention hours) and, if available, any existing technical documentation (diagrams, previous inspection reports).

Our quote request form was designed to capture this essential information from the first exchange, so our teams can come back to you with a suitable technical proposal as quickly as possible.
